item.title: Milipol 25 – eTricks Special Forces
item.description: The eTricks Special Forces is an all terrain eBike with a top speed of 55km/hr and a range up to 81km. It weighs in at 40kg and is equpped with 160mm of front suspension travel and chain drive, a hydraulic shock absorber with separate reservoir and its 20′ notched tire.

item.title: Centcom Launches Attack Drone Task Force in Middle East
item.description: U.S. Central Command announced today a new task force for the military’s first one-way attack drone squadron based in the Middle East. item.title: Milipol 25 – Snigel Combat Clothing
